newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse starts continuous trade index Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse starts continuous trade index Feb 3.

text.p: The Warsaw Stock Exchange will on February 3 start calculating its blue-chip WIG 20 index based on shares' performance in the bourse's continuous trading system, the bourse said in a statement on Friday.
The bourse said the index would be updated in five-minute intervals from the start of the continuous trading session until its close.
It said that in the absence of transactions for particular stocks the bourse would use a stock's main-market fixing price to help calculate the index.
Currently 21 issues trade in both the continuous system and the bourse's main single-price-auction system, with a total of 86 issues trading in the latter.
